annotations.title: Mark a beer, brewery or venue as a favorite (local)

description: Add a MANUAL favorite — a beer, brewery or venue — with an optional note, to the local cache. Local to the cache — NEVER writes to Untappd (Untappd has no favorites API for this). Re-adding an existing favorite updates its note (omit note to keep it) and keeps its created_at. Manual favorites show in untappd_favorites_list (source "manual") and as the `favorite` field on has_had, has_had_many, has_visited, brewery_beers, venue_menu, top_not_had and trip_check results; a favorite brewery also boosts its beers in untappd_top_not_had. Omit username for your own account.

kind.description: What the id is: a beer (bid), brewery (brewery_id) or venue (venue_id)

note.description: Why it is a favorite (shown as the reason)

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).
